SignedIn.note: Full pane: UserAvatar initials header, sign-in-methods section with GitHub (Primary) + Google + the password row, and the Sign out footer. Renders whole inside the capture viewport.

GitHubNeedsReconnect.note: needs_reauth status flows through to the Reconnect badge and a synthesized Google connect row; the destructive error line renders under the section.

WithConnectedServices.note: Third section present with two AccountConnectedServiceView rows (Authorized / Not connected) and their actions. All three sections read as one settings page.
